Our beginning

From Yafa to Cairo

Residing in 1900s Yafa, Palestine, the Nassar family were business owners and innovators. They owned a tahini factory and a hotel on the main road to Jerusalem, and invented a machine that made their products better and the process faster.

Following the 1948 war, the family fled Palestine and sought refuge in Egypt. There, the five brothers opened the same factory again in Cairo with the help of other investors.

The factory was eventually bought by Tadros Nassar, a grandson who purchased the shares of his uncles and the other investors. After his untimely death in 2015, the enterprise continued under his son and two daughters.

On the menu

Traditional staples, made and sourced with care

As of 2026, the factory produces its own tahini and tahini halawa, while also offering local Egyptian products selected for the same table.

Tahini طحينة

Sesame paste for dips, dressings, desserts, and everyday cooking.

Tahini Halawa حلاوة

A classic sesame sweet with a rich, nostalgic flavor.

Roasted Sesame سمسم محمص

Roasted sesame seeds for baking, toppings, and pantry staples.

Assal Esswed عسل أسود

Blackstrap molasses, deep and earthy with Egyptian roots.

Dolsi Olives زيتون دولسي

Olives grown in a Coptic Orthodox Monastery, similar to Kalamata Greek olives.

Zeit Har زيت حار

Linseed oil, a beloved local Egyptian specialty.
